name: mimo-usage-dashboard
description: MiMo Desktop local usage dashboard — a zero-AI Python CLI that renders HTML dashboards (token usage, cache hit rate, model share, session stats, context occupancy). Static snapshot by default; --open starts a loopback-only read-only refresh server.
author: Martin-soaring-dev
